boundary_condition: Nearby-to-downtown or a known distance from downtown satisfies the default; the hotel does not have to be located exactly downtown.
condition: When comparing hotel locations for an urban hotel stay where downtown access is relevant.
default_action: Prefer hotels that are downtown, close to downtown, near downtown, or have clear information about distance from downtown, while not requiring exact downtown placement.
exception_condition: If the current request explicitly says downtown is not necessary or makes another hotel feature more important, do not filter out otherwise suitable non-downtown hotels.
name: Downtown-proximate hotel location default
rationale: Multiple independent hotel-task instruction_ids show interest in downtown or near-downtown placement. One example says the hotel does not have to be downtown, so the coherent habit is a soft central-location preference rather than a hard downtown requirement.

source_evidence.contribution: The user asks how far the hotel is from downtown, showing downtown access is relevant.
The user explicitly wants the hotel to be downtown.
The user asks whether the hotel is near downtown.
The user requests something close to downtown.
The user says the room does not have to be downtown, supporting a soft preference rather than a hard requirement.
